Aa

Macrons

Consonantal i

Consonantal u

Theme

Playground equipment, sandbox toys, vehicles and play

bowling noun

also ten-pin bowling, bowl (verb), bowling alley, bowling ball, bowling pin, strike (in bowling)

modern

Traupman 46

cōnōrum lūdus, cōnōrum lūdī m.

cōnus, a cone, is classical (Plin.); the game is “the game of cones”.

Other words

  • cōnilūdium, cōnilūdiī n.

    noun, second declension · also used · modern · Traupman 46

Examples

  • globum volūtāre, cōnīs lūdere

    bowlTraupman 46

  • cōnōrum āreola

    a bowling laneTraupman 46

  • aedēs ad cōnilūdium

    a bowling alley (the building)Traupman 46

  • globus lūsōrius

    a bowling ballTraupman 46

  • cōnus lūsōrius

    a bowling pinTraupman 46

  • omnēs cōnōs simul dēcutere

    make a strikeTraupman 46
